events.title: Six UN staff killed in Gaza school strike; Lebanon violations mount
events.summary: Israeli strikes killed six UN workers and civilians at a school sheltering displaced families in Gaza as needs grow, according to the UN agency for Palestine refugees, UNRWA.

events.title: UN agencies warn humanitarian system in Sudan ‘could collapse’
events.summary: UN aid agencies on Monday said they may be forced to scale back humanitarian aid in Sudan – home of the world’s worst hunger and displacement crisis – due to funding shortfalls.

events.title: Civilians bear the brunt, with deadly US strikes in Iran and thousands displaced in Yemen
events.summary: Independent UN human rights investigators called for an immediate cessation of hostilities on Monday following a series of United States airstrikes on Iran in recent weeks that have killed civilians as tensions ripple through the region.
